description: Sets how a playlist plays: in order, shuffled, or by a custom order. See custom_order_* to create an arbitrary order defined by a script: it can pick the next item based on the time, the previously played item, and so on. For custom, `picks` are the first items it plays over the playlist as it is now (`id` is the media id) and `warnings` what the order could not do with this playlist.
name: playlist_set_playing_order
title: Set playing order
